name: Garden Wall
hint: Two friends make a tall step. Whoever gets up can let the others through.
why4: The wall is 4 high, so each climber needs two friends underneath; the plate on top needs the two climbers, so two bases plus two climbers.
solution: P1 stands against the wall at x=13; P2 jumps onto P1's head.
P3 jumps onto P2's head (top ~1.8), then jumps right onto the wall top (height 4). P4 does the same.
P3 and P4 stand on the plate at x=16-17 (2/2): gate A at the tunnel mouth (x=14) opens.
P2 hops down; P1 and P2 walk through the tunnel to the right side.
P3 and P4 jump down to the right. Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=27-28.
Someone hops the 2-high step at x=33-35 and touches the key at x=34; the carrier opens the door at x=40; all press Down.
